column2: Here's how you get a month of home-style lunches from Infinity Kitchens.
Start with today's menu. It's small, all vegetarian, and cooked fresh every morning.
Then pick a plan. Weekday Lunch is twenty-two lunches a month.
Choose your delivery window and your days, then tap continue.
At checkout, sign in and add your address once, with a note for the rider.
Pay with U P I or card.
That's it. Your plan is active, and all twenty-two lunches are scheduled.
Busy day? Skip a delivery from your account in two taps.
Infinity Kitchens. Home food, at home's pace.
